scope: Read-only Y and model contract audit; no fitting, association computation, source changes, or training.

main_answer.Y_identity: The exact backbone pathway is the reporting identity, while its Y is a typed vector of patient observations indexed by cohort/platform, omics layer, assay/feature and source method. It is not one scalar activity value.
main_answer.Y_formula: Y[i,k,p] = { y[i,p,d] : A[k,d]=1 }; M[i,k,p,d] = observed[i,p,d] AND source_eligible[p,d] AND applicability[i,k,p]==1.
main_answer.scope_hierarchy: Equivalent definitions may share identity and supply source-specific readouts. Non-equivalent overlapping broader/narrower/related definitions retain their own scope and provide structural context; their whole score is not silently the parent pathway label. TF/kinase activity can be an observation of an explicitly mapped backbone member. Source classification does not automatically add a separate loss.
main_answer.precise_core: For WNT, the KEGG N00056 canonical pathway remains exactly 46 members; the source readouts described below do not expand that member axis.
main_answer.not_all_context_is_subpathway: The admitted WNT links are protein_component_association, not verified is_a/part_of hierarchy edges. Gene-list overlap alone does not establish that every source is a child pathway.

WNT_real_example.name: Wnt signaling pathway, Canonical pathway
WNT_real_example.member_scope: All member measurements select the frozen 46-member backbone. Assay/isoform/site multiplicity explains more than46 phospho columns.
equivalent_readouts: same-backbone protein score (TCGA train-z gene-group mean, CPTAC protein ssGSEA)
CPTAC promoter-methylation pathway mean where measured
WNT_real_example.eligibility: All WNT bound dimensions are supervision_eligible=true. Missing patient values still mask out. TCGA GSK3B-iKiP has no observed value; CPTAC BRCA methylation score has no observed value. independent_loss_enabled=false means no automatic standalone task, not that the measurement is forbidden as a declared component target.
WNT_real_example.storage_correction: The four TF readouts are stored under a legacy STATE matrix layer but display_category=Pathway and measurement_layer=RNA_EXPRESSION; slides must call them RNA-derived TF readouts.

structural_examples.source: Reactome WNT ligand biogenesis and trafficking
Reactome TCF dependent signaling in response to WNT

WNT_real_example.outside_scope_effect: Outside-backbone proteins stay in their source definition/context, not in the exact46-member Y. Shared proteins have a unique measurement ID reused for membership links, not independent copies of the same assay.

proposed_matched_models.status: Design for the new fixed patient Y; not an already integrated training implementation.
proposed_matched_models.unit: Fit within cancer; patient is the training row; output dimension d is source/platform-specific measured value. Report model-supported lncRNA associations at cancer x lncRNA x exact pathway after fitting.
proposed_matched_models.M0: For each observation d and platform p, fit a linear Lasso: yhat[i,d,p] = alpha[d,p] + C[i]^T gamma[d,p] + X[i]^T beta[d,p]. Fit target centering/scaling, feature scaling, imputation and penalties inside training folds. Clinical and independent purity coefficients gamma are unpenalized. Compare all-lncRNA, mRNA and combined inputs with identical folds/output masks. This is a multi-output collection of linear regressions, not a regression of maxrho or a scalar pathway score.
proposed_matched_models.HHGT: Use the same observation axes, transformed values, missing masks, cohorts, patient folds and input-ablation sets. A patient-conditioned heterogeneous graph encoder carries lncRNA/gene/protein/regulator/pathway features and PPI/RPI/typed scope edges; observation/platform decoders predict the same y[i,d,p]. This patient-output adapter and decoder require implementation; the current relation head cannot consume this bundle unchanged.
proposed_matched_models.platform: TCPA antibody and CPTAC MS outcomes keep separate observation IDs and output heads. A cohort indicator in X alone cannot align their measurement scales; even training-set z-scores do not prove biological scale equivalence.
proposed_matched_models.loss: L = L_Pathway + 0.5 L_State + regularization, with explicit observed masks. Normalize losses by output count within each declared source/layer block and by blocks/targets, so large phosphosite panels or151Statechildren do not automatically dominate. Keep every source value separate. Shared observation IDs and derived-score/member dependencies require explicit weighting; repeated target links are not independent evidence.
proposed_matched_models.inputs: For a target layer, omit that layer and all deterministic derivatives of it from input, including graph-node features. For RNA tasks, lncRNA inputs remain valid if Y uses only protein-coding definitions; mRNA identities/defining genes must not be fed back as their own target, and direct gene-set reconstruction should be reported separately.
proposed_matched_models.lncrna_output: After fitting, compare held-out loss of a full model versus a matched refit without lncRNA l (or predeclared lncRNA group), aggregated over exact pathway observations using the same block weights: Delta[l,k]=Loss_k(model_without_l)-Loss_k(full). Combine with linear coefficient stability/graph perturbation and cohort replication. This is predictive contribution/association, not a new lncRNA-derived Y or causality; attention weights alone are not the result.
proposed_matched_models.topology_control: To attribute a gain to graph structure, HHGT no-edges/shuffled-edges comparison must retain identical input information, Y, masks and parameterization; plain expression-only M0 versus multiomic HHGT mixes information and architecture effects.

not_implemented_as_new_Y_training: No patient-conditioned HHGT observation decoder/prepared adapter for this bundle
actual_code_status.legacy_relation_adapter: model.py forward_task builds lncRNA/cancer/target candidates with numeric/base and returns one relation logit; it is not a patient measurement prediction.
actual_code_status.old_RMS_guard: m0_relation.py explicitly rejects observed_fused_rms_effect; multimodal_relation_y.py blocks legacy association-label materialization. train.py still includes legacy RMS metric/loss plumbing; do not assert every historical training path is blocked.
